open_decisions.title: WF-015 entitlement domain events (EntitlementReserved / EntitlementExecutionStarted) are owned by no built or planned component
open_decisions.authority: DECISIONS ADR-076 (S-07-003 contract lens); corrects ADR-075
open_decisions.note: ADR-075 accepted F-05 on the basis that 'the CONSUMING workflow' emits the entitlement events, and BUILD_STATE recorded 'S-07-003 must emit EntitlementReserved/LeaseRenewed'. The S-07-003 review found that binding is not implementable as written: API_CONTRACTS.md :907-910 assigns EntitlementReserved / EntitlementExecutionStarted / EntitlementCommitted / EntitlementReleased / EntitlementReservationExpired / EntitlementLeaseRenewed to WF-015 on the `entitlement_reservation` aggregate, and MTX-030 event_producer scopes Workflows::Wf005 to 'all seventeen events' of :737, which exclude them. A WF-005 handler therefore cannot emit them without violating the event catalogue. S-07-003 accordingly emits none; the durable Decision/reservation rows are written by F-05 and the entitlement outcome is carried in the WF-005 audit record (MTX-030 audit_record). EntitlementLeaseRenewed is separately NOT this tranche's: Heartbeat/Commit/ReleaseEntitlement are the `entitlement_reconcile` work type's operations (BACKGROUND_PROCESSING.md :217/:390). RESOLUTION REQUIRED: register S-22 (Entitlements and Usage, WF-015) as the owner of these events, or ratify a WF-005 limb. Not an S-07 dependency: no S-07 contract obligation is unmet.

open_decisions.title: F-05 Entitlement::Service#reserve implements only two of the six :541 short-circuit reasons
open_decisions.note: WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATIONS.md :541 fixes the Entitlement Decision precedence as organization_inactive, actor_inactive or service_unauthorized, entitlement_inactive, operation_unknown, policy_unavailable, counter_unavailable, reservation_conflict, hard_limit_exceeded, soft_limit_reached, within_limit. Platform::Entitlement::Service#reserve evaluates only entitlement_inactive, operation_unknown and the classify() limits; organization_inactive / actor_inactive / service_unauthorized are unreachable, so a Decision for a suspended Organization or an inactive Account persists as allow/within_limit in the IMMUTABLE entitlement_decisions row. S-07-003 closed the observable hole at the consumer (CB1: StartCrawl re-authorizes the Organization as its first gate limb, before reserve is reached), so no live path produces a false Decision today — S-07-003 is currently the only consumer. The foundation-level completeness spans every future high-cost consumer (reassessment.start, ai.generate, export.generate) and S-22 owns the entitlement surface. Fix in Entitlement::Service#reserve with the :541 precedence and recovery mapping (Organization -> reactivate_organization; actor -> reactivate_actor; service -> contact_support).
